info.title: ProjectX API
info.description: JEE/NEET question bank and practice API. Envelope: { data, meta? } | { error }. See docs/API_CONTRACTS.md.

reuse_permitted.description: Must be false on creation (422 otherwise); grant reuse via POST /admin/sources/{id}/approve

get.summary: Full taxonomy tree of an exam

get.description: Only PUBLISHED questions. An old slug returns 301 MOVED_PERMANENTLY (Location = new API path). ETag + If-None-Match supported.

get.summary: Chapter page with paginated question summaries
Stream a private object via signed token

get.description: Published questions only. Never contains answer_key, correct option ids, solution or explanation.

get.summary: Session detail (solutions only for attempted items)

post.description: Idempotent on client_attempt_id (optional Idempotency-Key header must equal it). Replay with same payload -> 200 meta.replayed; different payload -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

post.summary: Post a doubt (guest or signed in; never auto-public)

post.description: Raw image body (png/jpeg/webp, <= 5 MiB). Header X-Upload-Purpose: DOUBT_ATTACHMENT. Magic bytes are verified.

patch.description: ADMIN: any field. REVIEWER: metadata only (difficulty, chapter, topic, seo_*). Content fields on a PUBLISHED question -> 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

post.summary: Reject a solution or the question

post.description: Validates the publish guard (422 PUBLISH_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET with details.unmet), copies assets to PUBLIC_ASSETS, purges cache tags.

get.summary: Verification runs, AI runs, review history
